LESSON: MOVEMENT OF MATERIALS IN AND OUT OF THE CELL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 2.2: Movement of Materials in and out of the cell

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Movement of Materials in and out of the cell. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do materials move in and out of a cell?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
2. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things
3. appreciate the importance of diffusion and osmosis in living things

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MOVEMENT OF MATERIALS IN AND OUT OF THE CELL
This lesson teaches Movement of Materials in and out of the cell for Grade 8 INTEGRATED SCIENCE.

STUDY STEPS
1. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of diffusion and osmosis in living things
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Movement of Materials in and out of the cell using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell above.
2. Explain Movement of Materials in and out of the cell to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Movement of Materials in and out of the cell with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Movement of Materials in and out of the cell important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do materials move in and out of a cell?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things
2. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things
3. appreciate the importance of diffusion and osmosis in living things

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
